content.short: Fabwelt offers high-end blockchain games with in-game NFTs, Play-to-Earn, and DeFi.
content.description: Fabwelt is focused on delivering AAA-grade games on the blockchain, prioritizing polished, engaging experiences over experimentation. The goal is to create large-scale titles that blend familiar, competitive gameplay with on-chain ownership and monetization mechanics. One flagship title is Arsenal, a fast-paced first-person shooter reminiscent of Counter-Strike that incorporates blockchain features. In Arsenal, players can own and trade in-game items as NFTs, and a built-in earning mechanism rewards play, ensuring fun while enabling real user incentives.
content.meta: Fabwelt is a decentralized gaming project creating AAA blockchain games. Discover Fabwelt and other Decentralized Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
